overview.description: The TCW Multisector Credit Income ETF (MUSE) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in high yield fixed income. The fund is an actively managed fund that aims for long-term income. It invests in a broad basket of high-yielding fixed income securities globally MUSE was launched on Nov 15, 2024 and is issued by TCW.
